topic.label: Claude for Microsoft 365, Office Agents and Cowork
topic.desc: Claude for Microsoft 365, Office Agents and Cowork: Office agents overview, Office apps, Enterprise and operations.

concepts: Office agents overview: Overview, Changelog, Run tasks in the background with Dispatch, Install plugins, Organize work with projects, Monitoring, Set up Cowork (local mode) for a HIPAA-ready organization, Claude for M365 overview, Connectors and Skills.
Office apps: Use Claude for Excel, Use Claude for PowerPoint, Use Claude for Word, Use Claude for Outlook, Work across M365 apps, Use dictation in Claude for M365.

Enterprise and operations: Security, admin auditability, and analytics, Configure a custom OpenTelemetry collector, Performance and limits, Data storage and retention, Use Claude for M365 with third-party platforms, Install financial services plugins for Cowork.
skills: Learn about Cowork, Anthropic's agentic workspace
Run tasks in the background with Dispatch
Assign work to a Dispatch agent that plans, runs, and reports on tasks while you do something else, on this computer or from your phone.
Add packaged skills, connectors, and agents to Cowork from the plugin marketplace or a file.
Group folders, instructions, and context into a Cowork project so Claude starts each session with the right setup.
Track Cowork usage and activity across your organization with OpenTelemetry
Set up Cowork (local mode) for a HIPAA-ready organization
Prepare members' computers to run Cowork (local mode) under the HIPAA configuration. Covers the Claude Desktop policy, network limits, and local data.
Claude for Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook.
Extend Claude for Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook with external context and reusable task recipes.
An Excel add-in that integrates Claude into your spreadsheet workflow, for Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise plans.
A PowerPoint add-in that integrates Claude into your presentation workflow, for Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise plans.
A Word add-in that integrates Claude into your document workflow, for Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise plans.
An Outlook add-in that integrates Claude into your inbox and calendar, for Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise plans.
Let Claude read from one Microsoft 365 app and make changes in another in a single conversation.
Use dictation in Claude for M365
Speak your prompts instead of typing them in Claude for Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook.
Security architecture diagrams, OpenTelemetry audit, usage analytics, and spend tracking for enterprise admins deploying Claude for M365.
Route the full Claude for M365 audit trail, including prompts, tool inputs and outputs, and document references, to an OpenTelemetry collector you operate.
How Claude for M365 works with a busy Office app, the size limits to know, and what to do when Office slows down or stops responding.

Where Claude for M365 stores chat history, skills, and credentials on each user's device, why reinstalling or switching add-ins keeps that data, how long it is kept, and why the add-in asks users to sign in again.
Use Claude for M365 with third-party platforms
Deploy the Office add-ins through Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud Vertex AI, Azure AI Foundry, or an LLM gateway, without individual Claude accounts.
Install financial services plugins for Cowork
Add the open-source financial services plugin set to Cowork for workflows such as financial modeling, equity research, investment banking, and private equity.
